metaTitle: Dhathuru: island to island, door to door
metaDescription: Plan and book ferries, speedboats, seaplanes, flights, buses and taxis across the Maldives in one search, with honest connection buffers.
title: Island to island, door to door.
lead: Ferry, taxi, flight and taxi again, planned and booked together. Never a connection you can't make.

how.title: One search. The whole journey.
how.lead: No more stitching together ferry timetables, flight schedules and taxi calls.

search.title: Tell us where and when
search.body: Pick your island, your destination and either when you want to leave or when you must arrive.

check.title: We check every connection
check.body: Each hand-over gets a hard minimum buffer and a calculated chance of being missed. Fragile trips are flagged, not hidden.

book.title: Book it all at once
book.body: One checkout for every leg. A QR ticket for each ride, and a plan B ready if something runs late.

safe.title: We'd rather you arrive safely than quickly.
safe.body: A fast trip with a ten-minute scramble at the jetty isn't a good trip. Every option shows its buffers and its risk in plain numbers, with the reason it was ranked where it was.

points.buffers: Hard minimum buffers per connection, by mode and place
points.risk: Miss-risk from real delay history, shown on every option
points.why: A plain-language reason for every ranking

example.caption: Illustrative data, not a live timetable
example.ribbon: Journey: ferry, taxi, domestic flight, taxi

modes.title: Every way to get around the atolls
modes.lead: Public ferries, speedboats, seaplanes, domestic flights, buses and taxis, in one plan.

honest.title: Honest about what we know
honest.lead: Anything estimated or approximate says so, in the product and in the data.

fares.title: Taxi fares are estimates
fares.body: Where an operator has no published fare, we show an estimate and mark it as one.

routes.title: Sea routes are illustrative
routes.body: Lines on the map show the idea of a crossing. They are never a navigational chart.

times.title: Maldives time, always
times.body: Every time you see is Maldives time (UTC+5), so there is no mental arithmetic at the jetty.

cta.title: Where to next?
cta.body: Plan your first journey in under a minute.
